name: What is involved in the process of vanity and cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the process of vanity and cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your space. This is followed by design and material selection. Once materials arrive, old cabinets or vanities are removed. Then, new cabinets are precisely installed, ensuring they are level, secure, and properly aligned. Finally, countertops, hardware, and any necessary plumbing or electrical connections are completed. We ensure a clean and organized work environment throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, old unit removal, new cabinet installation, and finishing touches like hardware and connections.
